<?php
namespace Vendor149 {
interface Read149 { public function value(): int; }
class Base149 {
 public int $n = 0;
 public function __construct(int $seed) { echo 'base', $seed, '|'; $this->n = $seed; }
 public function value(): int { return $this->n; }
}
}
namespace Caller149 {
 $first = include __DIR__ . '/payload.php';
 $second = include __DIR__ . '/payload.php';
 echo $first::class, '|', $second::class, '|', $first->value(), '/', $second->value(), '|', $first === $second ? 'same' : 'fresh';
}

<?php
function mark149Nested() { echo 'arg|'; return 1; }
function accept149Nested($o) { echo $o::class, '|'; }
echo 'outer|';
eval('$o = new class(new class { public int $n = 3; }) { public function __construct($inner) { echo $inner::class, "|"; } }; echo $o::class, "|"; accept149Nested(new class(mark149Nested()) {});');

<?php
class Base149Choice {
 public int $n = 0;
 public function __construct(int $n) { echo 'ctor', $n, '|'; $this->n = $n; }
}
eval('$choose = true; $o = $choose ? new class(n: "7") extends Base149Choice {} : new class(n: 9) extends Base149Choice {}; echo $o::class, "|", $o->n, "|"; try { $bad = new class(n: "bad") extends Base149Choice {}; } catch (TypeError $e) { echo "type|"; } $tail = new class {}; echo $tail::class;');

<?php
function send149Missing($o) { echo 'callee|'; }
function side149Missing() { echo 'arg|'; return 2; }
echo 'root|';
try { eval('send149Missing(new class(side149Missing()) extends Missing149Base {});'); }
catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
eval('$tail = new class {}; echo $tail::class;');

<?php
echo "begin|";
eval(<<<'PHP'
namespace Review149Counter;
echo "inside|";
$and = false && new class extends MissingAnd149 {};
$one = new class {};
echo $one::class, "|";
$or = true || new class extends MissingOr149 {};
$two = new class {};
echo $two::class, "|";
$coalesce = 1 ?? new class extends MissingCoalesce149 {};
$three = new class {};
echo $three::class, "|";
$choose = false;
if ($choose) {
    $unvisited = new class extends MissingBranch149 {};
}
$four = new class {};
echo $four::class, "|";
echo $and ? "bad|" : "and|", $or ? "or|" : "bad|", $coalesce, "|";
PHP);
echo "end";

<?php
class Review149Base {
    public int $number = 0;
    public function __construct(int $left, int $right) {
        echo "ctor|";
        $this->number = $left + $right;
    }
}
interface Review149Read {
    public function read(): int;
}
$attempt149 = 0;
function review149_first() {
    echo "first|";
    return 4;
}
function review149_second() {
    global $attempt149;
    echo "second|";
    if ($attempt149 === 0) {
        $attempt149 = 1;
        throw new Exception("argument");
    }
    return 5;
}
echo "before|";
eval(<<<'PHP'
namespace Review149Factory;
use Review149Base as ParentAlias;
use Review149Read as ReadAlias;
function build149() {
    return new class(\review149_first(), \review149_second()) extends ParentAlias implements ReadAlias {
        public function read(): int { return $this->number; }
    };
}
try {
    $unused = build149();
} catch (\Exception $e) {
    echo $e->getMessage(), "|";
}
$a = build149();
$b = build149();
echo $a::class, "|", $a->read(), "|";
echo ($a::class === $b::class) ? "same|" : "wrong|";
echo ($a !== $b) ? "fresh|" : "wrong|";
$factory = static function () {
    return new class(\review149_first(), \review149_second()) extends ParentAlias implements ReadAlias {
        public function read(): int { return $this->number; }
    };
};
$c = $factory();
$d = $factory();
echo $c::class, "|", $c->read(), "|";
echo ($c::class === $d::class) ? "same|" : "wrong|";
echo ($c !== $d) ? "fresh|" : "wrong|";
PHP);
echo "after";

<?php
echo "outer|";
eval('false && new class { public int $n = "bad"; }; echo "pruned|";');
echo "middle|";
eval('echo "inner|"; function never149Default() { return new class { public int $n = "bad"; }; }');

<?php
eval(<<<'PHP'
namespace Review149Mixed;
function make149Mixed() {
    class Deferred149Mixed {}
    return new class extends Deferred149Mixed {};
}
$outside = new class {};
echo $outside::class, "|";
$inside = make149Mixed();
echo $inside::class, "|";
PHP);
eval('$tail = new class {}; echo $tail::class;');

<?php
class Review149FileBase {
 public int $n = 0;
 public function __construct(int $n) { echo 'ctor|'; $this->n = $n; }
}
echo 'begin|';
$o = include __DIR__ . '/payload.php';
echo $o::class, '|', $o->n, '|end';
